title: Choose the visual world
question: Re-roll 1: the roll assigned the Field Book. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Field Book
options.lineage: The yellow waterproof surveyor's level book every site engineer carries
options.thesis: His record booked like readings in a level book: ruled columns, red margin, every entry with its remark.
options.viewport: The book open on one gutter: left page his name, roles and contact; right page his career booked row by row (dates, project, result) with a site photo tipped in.
options.risk: Becomes a stationery costume if handwriting fonts or fake pencil creep in; entries must stay set type on the ruling.

raised.raise: The career runs as one unbroken line with a marker at 'now'.
Every element sits on the book's ruling; nothing off the line grid.
Every booked claim links to the document or photo that proves it.
Dates and figures set tabular, like booked readings.

options.label: Bill of Quantities
options.lineage: Tender BOQ and Program of Work documents
options.thesis: His career priced as a bill: item, description, quantity, unit, amount, with a totals band that is the call to hire.
options.viewport: A bordered bill headed with his name; rows 1.01 ICLS ₱1B+, 1.02 RFTI 2/2 sites, 2.01 PTB rehab; the totals band is contact / download CV.
options.risk: Tables everywhere can read like a spreadsheet: familiar to estimators, flat to everyone else.

options.label: Magazine Program
options.thesis: His career as an issue: masthead, strict two columns, one spot colour.
options.viewport: Masthead with his surname and an issue tag, a drop-cap summary beside a full-bleed site photo.
options.case: Clear and readable, but a lifestyle-magazine voice; engineers don't recognise themselves in it.
options.risk: Reads as a journalist's or designer's site, not an engineer's.

options.label: Step Row
options.case: Music gear, no tie to construction.
options.kept: One unbroken timeline with a 'now' marker.

options.label: Jacquard Brocade
options.kept: Full traceability from claim to source document.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern engineer's portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and roles beside a site photo, key numbers below, projects as case studies.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other portfolios by design.
